{{Quote|I am transporting cryogenic power cells. A large shipment.|translated=1|Lasavvou|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''Cryogenic power cells''' were designed as power sources for construction [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the wake of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. [[Lasavvou]], an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]], was delivering a large shipment of these to an unknown party on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[3951 BBY]]. When [[Gender/Legends|his]] contact did not show up, he did not have enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to pay the dock authority's fees for departing the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and he became stranded there. He gave one of these to [[Meetra Surik]] after she helped negotiate his free passage off the moon.

Cryogenic powers cells, such as [[Thiodyne/Legends|Thiodyne's]] [[03-R cryogenic power cell/Legends|O3-R cryogenic power cells]], were used as [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] components.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
